summary: Compiler-style guarded static-initialization wrapper. Registers an SEH frame, runs a one-time guard on a global init counter, and when the guard passes constructs six static objects (vtable-setup, allocation, and SEH-frame-setup helpers) linking them into a parent frame. Returns a saved context value.

operations.description: Set up the SEH frame by registering the global exception-handler table at unk_8D3BF4.
Store the incoming context value into the caller-provided return slot at (a1 - 20) and clear the object slot at (a1 - 16).
Enter the guarded region with helper sub_59A54D(a1 - 16).
Once-guard on a global init counter: when the counter is negative take the construction branch and set the local flag v2, otherwise increment the counter and skip construction.
Leave the guarded region with helper sub_59A5E9(a1 - 16).
For each of six static objects, store the object pointer at (a1 - 16) and its construction index (0 through 5) at (a1 - 4).
Guard each object pointer for non-null before invoking its constructor or allocation helper.
Construct the static objects through the vtable-setup, allocation, and SEH-frame-setup helpers.
Link constructed objects into the parent SEH frame: store child-object pointers into parent slots and set the try-level flag bit (OR 2) on one frame's state.
Return the saved context value read back from (a1 - 20).
